verdict.rationale: The README says users can 'Run and chat with' a model, and a community benchmark shows 'ollama run' used from the terminal, which points to terminal chat. However, no evidence states outright that `ollama run` opens an interactive, multi-turn REPL session, so the story is only partly documented. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of the interactive terminal chat session (REPL behavior, multi-turn conversation, session commands) and independent hands-on corroboration of interactive chat rather than one-off benchmark runs.

support.subject: As a developer, I can start an interactive chat session with a model directly from the terminal
